name: Rentokil Initial plc

listing.exchange: London Stock Exchange (FTSE 100); ADS on NYSE (RTO)

corporate_actions.event: Mike Duffy (ex-OnTrac CEO) succeeded Andy Ransom as CEO
Reorganised into two divisions (North America; International); Rafael Carrasco NA CEO from 3-Aug-2026; Phil Wood International CEO
Q3 2026 update: group organic +3.4%; NA pest +2.4%; $200m buyback; CFO to step down; NA residential and commercial separated
Terminix acquisition completed (~$6.7bn, part-paid in shares; NYSE ADS listing created) (recall)

geography.fx_notes: NA revenue $4.3bn of $6.9bn group (ESTIMATE 62%). Remainder Europe, UK & Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia & MENAT, Pacific (split not extracted; INFERENCE Europe ~18%, UK&SSA ~8%). Reports in USD since FY2024.

kpis.name: North America organic
kpis.value: FY25 total 2.3% (pest +1.1%, business services +8.9%); Q3-26 total 3.2% (pest +2.4%, business services +9.6%)

kpis.name: NA residential leads
kpis.value: Recovered to -1% y/y in September 2026 after weak Jul/Aug

kpis.name: Termite claims
kpis.value: Additional ~$47m legacy termite provision reported (single secondary source, unverified); NA 20% margin target for 2027 reportedly retired (unverified)

company_fcf.definition: Company FCF conversion = FCF / adjusted net income: 98% (absolute not extracted)

lease.source_id: IFRS filer (large vehicle fleet leases); not extracted - data gap

acquisitions.notes: Bolt-on M&A slowed post-Terminix to prioritise deleveraging; FY25 spend not extracted

management.cfo: Paul Edgecliffe-Johnson (stepping down, announced Oct-2026; name per recall)
management.senior_turnover_5y: High: CEO change 2026, NA CEO changes (interim Alain Moffroid, then Carrasco), CFO departure, chair exit planned
management.succession_notes: External CEO hire from US logistics; structure reset
management.guidance_record: Poor 2024-25: Terminix integration and NA organic repeatedly below plan; 2026 in line with market expectations

activists.name: Trian Fund Management (Nelson Peltz)
activists.objective: Improve NA execution/value (reported; stake size not found)

A.rationale: Recurring and diversified but residential NA volume weak.

evidence: Global #1 by revenue, but NA EBIT margins below Rollins
B.rationale: Scale advantage not yet visible in NA pricing/retention.

evidence: Group EBIT margin ~9% (provider, IFRS16) vs Rollins ~18%
Density benefits from branch consolidation still pending
NA integration synergies and route density still to come
D.rationale: Large self-help runway if execution improves.

evidence: NA ~62%, rest spread across Europe, UK, Asia, Pacific [S2]
CEO, CFO, NA CEO and chair changes 2025-26 [S3]

G.rationale: Largest deal value-destructive to date; balance-sheet repair underway.

evidence: Residential leads exposed to AI search channels (peer evidence)
Large field/back-office cost base; digital pest monitoring (PestConnect)
Low cyclicality; labour/vehicle costs; termite claims
J.rationale: Resilient demand with some cost exposures.

K.rationale: Good cash conversion but heavy adjustments.

ai.notes: None. Residential lead generation channel risk as for Rollins.

sector_specific.terminix_integration: Branch consolidation/system migration; NA residential and commercial separated Oct-2026

gates.notes: Company net debt/EBITDA 2.6x (Dec-25); provider (incl. leases) 3.0x. G4 likely C (98% FCF conversion) - lead to confirm on standardised basis. UK listing but NA-dominated revenue; not UK consumer.

bull_points: Self-help recovery: NA integration and density synergies could re-rate margins toward Rollins levels.
New CEO, divisional structure and buyback signal capital discipline.
Global footprint diversifies away from US-only peers.
bear_points: NA pest organic only ~1-2.4% for two years; Terminix thesis largely unproven.
Extensive leadership churn (CEO, CFO, NA CEO, chair) raises execution risk.
Legacy termite claims and adjusting items blur earnings quality.
thesis_breakers: NA pest organic growth below 2% in FY2027.
Further material termite provision increases (> $50m) in 2027.
